operation.title: Harden the E3 coverage protocol before data arrives
operation.authority_change: NONE. Transfers no review authority, requests no disposition.

headline.critical: No corpus was supplied and no derivation authority was granted in the directing message. None was fabricated and no source was ingested. E3 COVERAGE: UNMEASURED — CORPUS ABSENT is unchanged and remains correct.
headline.what_was_done: The protocol instructions in that message were implementable without a corpus. Hardening the measurement rules before data arrives is when it is cheap; after data arrives, every rule is contestable as post-hoc.

first_measurement_threshold.behaviour: Below either, the report reads INSUFFICIENT_CORPUS / UNMEASURED with NO per-rule rates at all.
first_measurement_threshold.rationale: Rates computed under threshold would dress noise as topology.

first_pass_discovery_only.behaviour: Only discovery spans count toward the threshold; validation and holdout are not burned while the annotation ontology is still unproven against real conversation.

none_is_required.behaviour: An empty human_labels array is REFUSED. Nothing-witnessed must be an explicit NONE label.
none_is_required.rationale: An omitted array cannot be distinguished from an unannotated span, and a corpus biased toward positives makes precision meaningless. A NONE span the detector fires on is a counted false activation.

synthetic_fixtures_refused.behaviour: A span marked SYNTHETIC_FIXTURE is rejected by the loader.
synthetic_fixtures_refused.rationale: Proof fixtures remain regression specimens. The question is what the detector sees in language it did not help manufacture.

protocol_hardened.evidence_span: Annotations now record the exact substring the annotator witnessed the event in, comparable against the detector's matched_excerpt.

miss_taxonomy.significance: The fourth is not a defect. Coverage is not maximisation — a detector that sees everything has begun interpreting. expected_disposition marks it and those spans are reported separately.

findings.finding: Four earlier shape specimens (COV-07..COV-10) tested report structure against tiny span sets and began tripping the new threshold gate.
findings.disposition: Padded to threshold rather than exempted from it. Exempting them would have created a second, weaker measurement path.

findings.finding: COV-05 (partition overlap) used an empty human_labels array as its fixture. After the NONE law it began failing for the empty-labels reason, so it would have passed while no longer testing partition overlap at all.
findings.disposition: Fixture given a real NONE label so the test exercises the law it names.

findings.finding: coverage/README.md still stated that an empty human_labels array is a valid 'nothing witnessed' label, directly contradicting the new refusal, and still advertised 12 assertions.
findings.disposition: Corrected. A README contradicting the code it documents is the stale-scope-note failure in another place.

core_frozen.verified: kernel/e3.py remains byte-identical to the digest at e3-extension-verified-v0.1 (COV-01, COV-02).

standing.unchanged: All authority standing carried forward unaltered.

unresolved.item: No transcript corpus exists. 100 node turns across >=10 conversations are required before any coverage conclusion.
No annotator, blind-annotation protocol, or inter-annotator agreement measure is established.
The harness scores single spans; E3D-004 (multi-turn) still cannot be measured by it.
MIN_TURNS=100 and MIN_CONVERSATIONS=10 are the directing authority's judgement, not a derived statistic. No power analysis backs them.
E3 is verified as an authority boundary, not as a useful detector.
db/005 names E3D-004 as the exceptional structural rule.

next_authority.act_required: Supply a real transcript corpus, OR authorise derivation of a privacy-safe corpus from a specific named source, OR select a different frontier.
next_authority.note: The directing message described this act but did not perform it. Nothing on measurement can proceed without it. The RC-0001 item remains separately open.
